recent_posts.title: Announcing the Netography MCP Server: AI-Powered Insight Into Your Network Activity
recent_posts.summary: Netography has released an open-source MCP server that enables natural language interaction with network monitoring data through AI assistants like Claude and Copilot. The server provides a bridge between Netography Fusion APIs and AI chat tools, allowing security teams to investigate network traffic, analyze suspicious activity, and gather intelligence using conversational prompts. Users can ask questions like 'Find top IPs by flow' or 'Show DNS traffic to external resolvers' and receive actionable network insights. The tool is read-only for security, requires a Netography Fusion API key, and supports Claude Desktop and VS Code with specific configuration instructions available on GitHub.

recent_posts.title: Why frictionless detection is replacing traditional network security sensors
recent_posts.summary: Traditional network security tools like IDS and NDR systems struggle with modern distributed, encrypted environments due to complex deployment, visibility gaps, high costs, and slow implementation. Frictionless network detection offers a cloud-native alternative that uses existing flow logs from cloud providers instead of physical sensors, providing rapid deployment, holistic visibility across hybrid environments, encrypted traffic analysis through behavioral patterns, reduced operational overhead, and lower total cost of ownership.

recent_posts.title: Microsoft Is Retiring Azure NSG Flow Logs—Here’s What You Need to Do
recent_posts.summary: Microsoft is retiring Azure NSG flow logs with new creation blocked from June 30, 2025, and complete deletion by September 30, 2027. Organizations must migrate to VNet flow logs, which offer deeper visibility into all IP traffic, better metadata, and improved lateral traffic monitoring. VNet flow logs provide broader resource coverage and enhanced security observability compared to NSG logs that only capture traffic governed by NSG rules.

recent_posts.title: Insider Risk Mitigation: Enhancing Detection Fidelity
recent_posts.summary: The cost of insider incidents has risen to $17.4 million annually in 2024. Reducing time to containment and response is crucial for managing insider risks, with early detection significantly lowering costs. The Carnegie Mellon's guide emphasizes the critical monitoring period around employee terminations. Netography Fusion offers detection, visualization, and search capabilities across on-prem and cloud environments to enhance security and reduce insider threats.

recent_posts.title: Understanding Zero Trust Architecture and Its Pitfalls
recent_posts.summary: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) aims to enhance network security by employing components such as encryption, Identity & Access Management (IAM), microsegmentation, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and real-time monitoring. However, these systems can fail due to factors like misconfiguration and lack of proper implementation. Monitoring network activity is crucial to detect policy enforcement failures and security incidents. The Netography Fusion® platform provides a comprehensive solution for real-time monitoring, reducing complexity, validating controls, and lowering total cost of ownership (TCO) through its cloud-native SaaS model.

recent_posts.title: Soft segmentation: Easy mode ransomware defense
recent_posts.summary: Ransomware continues to be a significant cyber threat, with attacks costing businesses nearly a billion dollars in 2024. Persistent cyber groups like Ghost Ransomware target various industries using well-known vulnerabilities. Effective defense strategies include network segmentation, robust authentication, and strict file controls. Netography introduces soft segmentation as a pragmatic approach, utilizing network flows and cloud DNS data to detect and mitigate ransomware threats without the complexities of traditional segmentation. Soft segmentation helps isolate vulnerable devices and enables security teams to enforce policies without disrupting legitimate traffic.

recent_posts.title: Netography® Expands Wiz Integrations (WIN) Platform with Holistic View of Malicious Activity Targeting Vulnerable Assets and Post-Compromise Activity Including Lateral Movement and Data Exfiltration
recent_posts.summary: Netography announces an expanded integration with Wiz Integrations (WIN) platform, enhancing the visibility and detection of malicious activities targeting vulnerable assets. This integration aims to reduce cloud security risks by providing real-time insights into network vulnerabilities and post-compromise activities, improving overall cyber resilience and operational security for organizations using multi-cloud environments.

recent_posts.title: Accelerating Threat Detection and Mitigation with Wiz + Netography Integration
recent_posts.summary: Integrating the Wiz Cloud Security Platform with Netography's Fusion Platform enhances the ability to detect and mitigate security threats in multi-cloud environments. This partnership provides a unified view of cloud security risks, improves network observability, and allows for real-time threat detection and response. The integration simplifies vulnerability management, identifies critical exposure paths, and addresses issues like misconfigurations. It also accelerates incident response and improves security program effectiveness.

recent_posts.title: Accelerate Your Security Operations with Fusion’s MITRE ATT&CK Events View
recent_posts.summary: Netography Fusion® platform enhances security operations by mapping over 300 detection models to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, facilitating faster responses to malicious activities. It provides a comprehensive view of network activity across multi-cloud and hybrid environments and delivers high-confidence alerts for efficient threat hunting and investigations. The platform ingests various network metadata, enriches it for context, and enables real-time responses to security threats.

recent_posts.title: AI-Enhanced Attacks Accelerate the Need for Hybrid, Multi-Cloud Network Security and Observability
recent_posts.summary: Generative AI is expected to be involved in 17% of cyberattacks within the next two years, with uses such as phishing, credential stuffing, and exploiting vulnerabilities. Enterprises with hybrid, multi-cloud networks face challenges in detecting and responding to these AI-enhanced threats due to the complexities of their environments. Tools like Netography Fusion offer network security and observability across these modern networks by ingesting flow logs and using AI-powered analytics to detect malicious activities. This helps organizations improve their detection and response capabilities in real-time.
